channel.title: With Raspberry Pi
channel.description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Config Command: raspi-config Quick Reference
item.description: Looking for the Raspberry Pi config command? Open sudo raspi-config, enable SSH, I2C, or SPI, and use nonint commands on Raspberry Pi OS Trixie.

item.title: Tips & Advanced Techniques
item.description: Tips & Advanced Techniques. Follow practical Raspberry Pi setup steps, configuration examples, best practices, security guidance, and troubleshooting tips.

item.title: Raspberry Pi get_throttled: Decode 0x50000 and Undervoltage
item.description: Decode Raspberry Pi get_throttled values such as 0x50000 and 0x50005. Separate current faults from history, check power and cooling, and verify recovery.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Temperature Command: Check CPU Heat and Throttling
item.description: Check Raspberry Pi CPU temperature with vcgencmd and thermal_zone0, detect throttling, configure Pi 5 cooling, log readings, and create practical alerts.

item.title: raspi-config Not Working: Command Not Found and nonint Errors
item.description: Fix raspi-config command not found and nonint errors on Raspberry Pi OS. Check packages, sudo, terminal access, option syntax, and the resulting settings.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Troubleshooting Hub
item.description: Raspberry Pi Troubleshooting Hub. Follow Raspberry Pi setup, configuration, best practices, and troubleshooting steps. Includes tested examples.

item.title: llama.cpp Mlock Failed on Raspberry Pi: Limits and Load Modes
item.description: Fix llama.cpp mlock errors on Raspberry Pi. Compare --load-mode options, inspect locked-memory limits, verify systemd settings, and distinguish OOM failures.

item.title: llama.cpp on Raspberry Pi: Mlock, Build & Benchmark
item.description: Build llama.cpp on Raspberry Pi with CMake. Choose GGUF models, tune context and load modes, diagnose memory locking, benchmark tokens/s, and serve a local API.

item.title: Raspberry Pi NetworkManager: nmcli Setup and Troubleshooting
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi NetworkManager with nmcli on Bookworm or Trixie. Fix Wi-Fi, static IP, DNS, SSH lockouts, and network-manager update failures.

item.title: Raspberry Pi NetworkManager Update Failed: APT Repair
item.description: Fix Raspberry Pi network-manager update failures by separating DNS, repository, disk-space, and interrupted dpkg errors while preserving SSH access.

item.title: Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode 2026: SSH over USB
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Mode on Trixie for SSH over one USB cable. Covers Imager, rpi-usb-gadget, supported models, Windows, macOS, Linux, and fixes.

item.title: Raspberry Pi USB Gadget Not Working: usb0, dwc2, g_ether
item.description: Diagnose missing usb0 on Raspberry Pi USB gadgets. Check the data cable, USB device controller, dwc2, g_ether, host enumeration, addresses, and SSH.

item.title: Raspberry Pi dwc2 USB Ethernet Gadget Setup
item.description: Build a manual Raspberry Pi USB Ethernet gadget with dwc2 and g_ether when the Trixie package is unsuitable. Covers static IP, SSH, host setup, and recovery.

item.title: Raspberry Pi 5 Headless Setup: First Boot and SSH
item.description: Set up a Raspberry Pi 5 without a monitor using Imager, Ethernet or Wi-Fi, and SSH keys. Check first-boot power, status LED, IP address, and login errors.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Headless Setup 2026 with Imager and SSH
item.description: Set up Raspberry Pi headless in 2026 with Imager, Wi-Fi, SSH keys, Ethernet, or USB Gadget Mode. Includes first-boot checks, discovery, security, and recovery.

item.title: Raspberry Pi Remote Desktop on Trixie: Connect, VNC, RDP, and SSH
item.description: Set up secure Raspberry Pi remote desktop on OS Trixie. Compare Connect, WayVNC, VNC, RDP, and SSH; fix headless displays, security, and slow sessions.

item.title: Secure VNC on Raspberry Pi OS: Wayland and Headless
item.description: Enable VNC on Raspberry Pi OS Desktop, diagnose a black screen, and connect through a LAN, VPN, or SSH tunnel without forwarding VNC to the public internet.

item.title: 03. UART "Hello World" - First Output from Our OS
item.description: Print Hello World over UART in a bare-metal Raspberry Pi OS. Explore ARM64 serial setup, wiring, code, debugging, and common first-output failures.

item.title: Raspberry Pi User Guide: Complete Tutorials & Projects
item.description: Discover comprehensive Raspberry Pi tutorials, projects, and guides. Master programming, hardware setup, low-level assembly, OS development, and debugging.

item.title: Chromium Google Sync on Raspberry Pi: What Works
item.description: Chromium on Raspberry Pi cannot use Google browser sync. See how to sync bookmarks and passwords, or use Chrome ARM64 for full Google Account sync.
